response: A detailed analysis of sputum and systemic inflammation in asthma phenotypes has revealed that a significant eosinophilic inflammation is present across all categories of asthma. This suggests that paucigranulocytic asthma, which was previously thought to be non-inflammatory, may actually be a low-grade inflammatory disease. In other words, paucigranulocytic asthmatics are not entirely non-inflammatory, but rather, they exhibit a milder form of inflammation compared to other asthma phenotypes. This finding highlights the complexity of asthma and the need for further research to understand the underlying mechanisms of different asthma phenotypes.
